description: 1031 exchange deadlines and boot — Offline like-kind exchange (IRC 1031) planner: 45-day identification and 180-day exchange deadlines capped by the tax-return due date (extension=true for Oct 15), days left and status; with sale_price it computes realized gain, cash and mortgage boot, recognized vs deferred gain, replacement basis, 3-property/200%/95% identification rules and an equal-or-up check. Params: sale_date=YYYY-MM-DD (required); sale_price, basis, selling_costs, old_debt, new_price, new_debt, cash_added, cash_received, extension, today. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_1031_exchange
